review_description: Bought original 5kw solar panels and inverter from this company over 10 years ago for over $20000, with 25 year solar generating guaranty.  7 years later the inverter broke, spent another $1000 for a new inverter with 10 year warranty.  2 years later now, the whole system is not working.  Asked them to come and check, they never got back to me.  It's almost 3 months now, the case is now with Fair trading NSW.
Great learning process. Professional installation. Quick turnaround on any issue n query.
It was also one of the companies that you recommend and their price was very good.
Easy to deal with and a great installation team

I had 13 panels installed (total 3.38kw) with a Growatt 5kw Inverter for $3,800.The customer service was excellent and despite a problematic installation due to meter box being quite some distance from my townhouse, the process was completed most satisfactorily. A 4 hour job turned into a 10 hour job but I was not charged anything extra and I was very happy with the final result.
